_comment: FX-GHA-01: GitHub App flow — install session, callback exchange, HMAC-SHA256 vectors, delivery dedupe. Views github.py:658-808,860-956; utils github_app_auth.py:33-210 (EXECUTED: normalize_private_key, parse_github_datetime, HMAC verify logic).

branch_table.when: ANY exception in exchange/verify/fetch/upsert (broad except, logged) [github.py:780-793]

branch_table.terminal_passthrough: session exists but status != STARTED -> redirect github_app=<status> (completed/expired/failed replay) [github.py:763-764]

callback_get.redirect_base: WEB_URL or APP_BASE_URL or '' + /settings/profile/integrations/?<params> (urlencode) [github.py:140-147]; success params {github_app: connected, workspace_slug} [github.py:803-808]

config.get_github_app_config: reads GITHUB_APP_ID/SLUG/PRIVATE_KEY/WEBHOOK_SECRET/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET via get_configuration_value; strips; private key normalized [github_app_auth.py:33-51]
config.require: oauth adds client_id+client_secret; webhook adds webhook_secret; missing -> GithubAppConfigError('GitHub App config missing: ...') [github_app_auth.py:63-73]

delivery_dedupe.dedupe_key: delivery_id UUID (400 Missing/Invalid X-GitHub-Delivery; JSON 400 Invalid JSON) [github.py:878-889]
delivery_dedupe.redeliver_rule: REPEAT only when prior status PROCESSED/SKIPPED -> 202 {status} fast-return; RECEIVED/FAILED REPROCESSED (crash-safe; _refresh_pr_links idempotent + out-of-order guarded) [github.py:904-917]
delivery_dedupe.terminal: every path ends 202; status is processed|skipped|failed (RECEIVED never escapes: the save block always re-marks before responding) [github.py:917,956]

event_routing.unknown_installation: installation/installation_repositories with no local row -> SKIPPED [github.py:932-933]

hmac_vectors.rejects: missing signature or not startswith 'sha256=' -> False [github_app_auth.py:203-204]

errors.error: You must be a workspace admin...

install_start.route: POST /users/me/integrations/github/app/install/ (authenticated, no role decorator — admin checked manually) [github.py:658-664]

jwt_headers.app_headers: {Authorization: Bearer <RS256 app JWT iat=now-60 exp=now+540 iss=app_id>, Accept: application/vnd.github+json, X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28, User-Agent: pi-dash-github-app} [github_app_auth.py:76-94]
jwt_headers.installation_token_cache: key github_app_installation_token:<id>; ttl = max(60, expires_at-60s), default 55min (55*60); revoke deletes [github_app_auth.py:178-198]

webhook_route: POST /integrations/github/app/webhook/ AllowAny, authentication=[], throttle=[] (signature IS the auth; AnonRateThrottle would 429 bursts) [github.py:863-867]; disabled-flag 404 BEFORE signature check [github.py:870-871]
